newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan chip makers' 96/97 profit seen falling - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan chip makers' 96/97 profit seen falling - paper.

text.p: Some Japanese semiconductor makers, including Hitachi Ltd and Mitsubishi Electric Corp, are expected to see their profits fall in the current business year to March 31, 1997, due to the sluggish chip market, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily said that it expects Hitachi's parent current profit in 1996/97 to fall 38 percent year-on-year to about 80 billion yen.
It sees Mitsubishi Electric's 1996/97 parent current profit falling 31 percent year-on-year to about 70 billion yen.
Spokesmen for the firms were not available for comment.
